tagline: Step on three coloured pads to knock over three rows of dominoes, then reach the green exit.
overview:
Domino Dynamo is a tiny first-person chain-reaction game, built as a quick physics experiment. A dark square room holds three rows of tall domino slabs (red on the left, yellow in the middle, blue on the right) and three matching pressure pads along the near wall. A green exit door waits on the far wall.

Step on a pad and the first domino of its row gets a shove: the row clatters down with real physics. Fire all three banks and the exit opens; walk into it to win. The exit stays locked until every bank has fallen.
story: A small reactor room full of domino banks, wired to three pressure pads by the door. Each bank has to be tipped before the exit lets anyone out, and the real reward is watching the slabs topple into each other.
goal: Trigger all three domino banks (BANKS 3), then walk into the green exit: VICTORY. There is no way to lose.
rules: Each coloured pad by the wall fires its row of dominoes once: red (left), yellow (middle), blue (right).
BANKS counts the rows you have fired.
The green exit on the far wall only opens once BANKS is 3.
